verdict.gold_reason: Article 22(4)(a) of Regulation 2019/943 says capacity that started commercial production on or after 4 July 2019 and emits more than 550 g CO2 of fossil fuel origin per kWh of electricity cannot be committed or receive payments under a capacity mechanism. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is a paraphrase of Article 22(4)(a): 'newly started plants' maps to capacity starting production on or after 4 July 2019, and 'paid for standing ready' maps to capacity mechanism payments. Only one threshold applies to new plants.
